limits: Both arms are Flashwright release drivers. No Playwright leadership or representative majority-scenario 2x claim.
Four balanced launch pairs per workload do not establish tail behavior; maxima are observed maxima. No unfavorable valid samples were removed.

Browser flow includes launch, context/page creation, navigation, trusted actions, export and teardown. Supervised whole-command time additionally includes fixture preparation and independent archive replay verification.
Original-owner inclusive wait4 CPU and sampled concurrent RSS are retained diagnostics. Complete process-tree custody and final matched-resource admission remain unverified.

Browser argv, kernel boot identity and resource policy were not bound at every performance boundary. Fixed owned launch policy is unchanged; host metadata below was observed at analysis, not authenticated for every launch.
Current full-core integration, refreshed macOS, native CI, release acceptance and representative application performance remain separate open gates.
retainedAttempts: Earlier 44-launch comparison passed on the pre-guard binary. It is retained separately and not pooled with this final binary campaign.

Final guard bounds removed-node iteration when the cache admits no entries. The negative control visited all 5000 supplied removals before the fix; the corrected control stays within 4096 combined visits.
Initial analysis expected 124 snapshots for every workload. Dynamic forms execute an additional verification evaluation and correctly record 126; all original samples and timings remain included.
